hints.title: Level by Level Accumulation
hints.text: Traverse the tree level by level, computing the total sum of all node values located at each discrete depth.

hints.title: Breadth Queue Wave
hints.text: At each level wave, record current level sum and enqueue children of all current nodes for the next wave.

hints.title: Track Maximal Level
hints.text: Compare the level sum to the running maximum sum. If strictly greater, update both the maximum sum and the 1-indexed level number.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Visiting each level with independent depth queries takes quadratic O(N * H) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A level-order queue visits every node once in linear time using width-bounded queue storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement clean level-by-level breadth-first traversal and handle negative node values correctly.
complexity.notes: Initial maximum sum should be initialized to negative infinity.
